name: Jimmy Sheptock Single Leg System
description: Jimmy Sheptock’s The Single Leg Takedown is a wrestling course covering tie clearing, head-inside finishes, whizzer problems and low finishes.
summary: Wrestling setups and single-leg finishes, including whizzer and low-position problems.
overview: The Single Leg Takedown follows Jimmy Sheptock’s wrestling approach from closing distance and clearing ties to finishing the captured leg. High finishes, low finishes and responses to the whizzer give it more depth than a course about the initial shot alone. Its setting is wrestling, which matters when choosing it for a jiu-jitsu takedown game.

related_content.name: Aaron Benzrihem Ankle Pick System
related_content.relationship: Basics To Advanced: Ankle Picks For Jiu Jitsu covers a different takedown family with standing, seated-guard and gi-grip entries.

products.title: The Single Leg Takedown
products.blurb: Four parts covering single-leg setups, finishes and common wrestling defenses.
products.best_for: Grapplers seeking wrestling-specific depth on the single-leg takedown.

fits: You want wrestling detail on tie clearing and head-inside single legs.
You need more finishing options when the defender applies a whizzer or the exchange drops low.
consider_alternative_if: Your main need is submission defense or choosing a guard-passing position after the takedown.

includes: Closing distance, head position and clearing collar, underhook, wrist and two-on-one ties.
Head-inside single-leg finishes from high and low positions.
Whizzer responses, high-crotch transitions, crackdowns and misdirection finishes.
limits: The four-part course is a wrestling instructional; submissions and guard landings are not its advertised focus.
